chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to us from Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Sulaiman al-Baghandi, who reported from Harun ibn Hatim, who reported from Ismail ibn Tawbah and Mus'ab ibn Sallam, from Abu Ishaq, from Rabi'ah al-Sa'di, who said:

I came to Hudhaifah ibn al-Yaman, may God have mercy on him, and said to him: "Narrate to me what you heard from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, or what you saw him do, so that I may act upon it." He said to me: "Adhere to the Quran." I said: "I have already read the Quran, and I have only come to you so that you narrate to me what I have neither seen nor heard. O God, I make You my witness against Hudhaifah that I came to him to narrate to me what I have neither seen nor heard from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, yet he has refused me and concealed it from me."

Hudhaifah then said: "O you, you have pressed me hard." Then he said: "Take this short one from a long list, and a comprehensive answer for all your concerns: The sign of Paradise for this community is its Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, though he ate food and walked in the markets." I said to him: "Show me the sign of Paradise in this community so I may follow it, and show me the sign of the Fire so I may guard against it."

He said to me: "By Him in Whose hand is my soul, the sign of Paradise and the guides to it until the Day of Resurrection, and the Imams of truth, belong to the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them. And the sign of the Fire, the leaders of disbelief, and those who call to the Fire until the Day of Resurrection, belong to others besides them."

key_terms.آل محمد: The family of Muhammad -- refers to Ahl al-Bayt, the Prophet's household
key_terms.آية: Sign, mark -- used here to mean the identifying marker that distinguishes truth from falsehood
key_terms.أئمة الحق: The Imams of truth -- the rightful leaders who guide the community in accordance with divine truth
key_terms.الهداة: The guides (plural of hadi) -- those who guide people on the right path

ai.seo_question: What did Hudhaifah ibn al-Yaman say about the sign of Paradise and the family of Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Rabi'ah al-Sa'di persistently asks Hudhaifah ibn al-Yaman -- a Companion known as the keeper of the Prophet's secrets -- to share prophetic teachings beyond what is in the Quran. After initial reluctance, Hudhaifah swears by God that the sign of Paradise and the true guides to it until the Day of Resurrection are the family of Muhammad (Ahl al-Bayt), while the sign of Hellfire and the leaders of disbelief belong to their opponents.
